name: New Seller Listing
summary: Taking a listing from signed agreement to closed sale.

tasks.label: Add Property Address & Target Price
tasks.hint: The address as it will appear on the listing, and the number you agreed on.

tasks.label: Add Seller Timeline
tasks.hint: When they need to be out, and anything that cannot move.
tasks.placeholder: Listing by 20 Sep, must close before 15 Nov

tasks.label: Upload Signed Listing Agreement
tasks.hint: You cannot market the property until this comes back signed.

tasks.label: Upload Seller Property Disclosure
tasks.hint: Every known defect. This is the one that causes lawsuits when it is rushed.

tasks.label: Book the photographer
tasks.hint: Tick once the shoot is confirmed and the sellers know to have it tidy.

tasks.label: Put the listing live on the MLS
tasks.hint: Tick once it is published and the photos have come through.

tasks.label: Upload Closing Disclosure
tasks.hint: Check the net proceeds against what you quoted the seller.
